1.note: Lam 2:1 opens איכה יעיב and Lam 4:1 איכה יועם; seg. 34 names יועם among the three-measure chapters and seg. 35 then says יועם resembles them. Seg. 127 has יעיב; the author's text is kept as is.

2.he: ושני ההויה אשר בתפלת חבקוק פסוק ה׳ שמעתי שמעך
2.note: The two Tetragrammata of 'O Lord, I have heard the report of You... O Lord, Your work' are in Hab 3:2, not verse 5; the author's number is kept.

3.he: שלישי באחים פרווינצ״אלי ... ר׳ יהודה בעל ספר נפוצות יהודה
3.note: Nefutzot Yehudah is by Judah Moscato, who was not a Provenzali; the phrase may refer to two people or be compressed. Translated as printed.

4.note: The bracketed query is in the printed Hebrew itself, marking an uncertain word.

5.note: The sense is unclear. It is rendered 'intermittently' from context.

6.he: גם אם עלי של יהי מכה בתוך מאה חמושים
6.note: The line is obscure; של is taken as 'error' (cf. 2 Sam 6:7). The image of the blow among a hundred armed men is uncertain.

7.note: The meaning of the 'breadth of fifty by fifty' is unclear; it is rendered literally.
